about: The introitus of the formulary “Exaltation of the Holy Cross” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: As for us, we must glory in the Cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, in whom lies our salvation, our life, and our resurrection, through whom we were saved and set free. May God have mercy on us and bless us, make His face shine over us, and have mercy on us. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. As for us, we must glory in the Cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, in whom lies our salvation, our life, and our resurrection, through whom we were saved and set free.
